audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty 4/10 EVEN is too generous for a 48.69% matchup over 191 games, and the level charts overstate the early lane: full phases and content win[] both give Gragas levels 1 and 3 and the two-item stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Sejuani, and the existing whys already say level 1 is 'a wash', level 3 'stays even' and that she out-scales.
audit.corrected: Level 1 even, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 even, Levels 4-5 Gragas, Level 6 even, first item Gragas, two items Sejuani.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never carry a cooldown number. Arctic Assault is an 18s knockup at rank 1 and Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown gated purely on Frost stacks — those two facts define when her all-in exists.
audit.why: enemyKit Q cd 18/16.5/15/13.5/12; E cd 1.5 with 'stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks'. Tracking 'Permafrost's cooldown' as the page repeatedly says is misleading — E is almost always up.
audit.corrected: Track Frost stacks and her 18s Arctic Assault, not Permafrost's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are absent: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so Barrel Roll's slow does nothing while it is up; and her passive shatters a STUNNED enemy for massive magic damage, which is why eating Permafrost costs far more than the stun duration.
audit.why: Riot passive text: 'Frost Armor ... immunity to slows ... Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.' Frost Armor only persists a short time after she takes damage, so breaking it first is the sequencing rule.
audit.corrected: Break Frost Armor with an auto or barrel before you rely on the slow; never be the stunned target, because her passive shatter is the real damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is quoted at 13 seconds.
audit.why: ownerKit E cd is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer boilerplate calls Sejuani 'he' and 'his' throughout.
audit.why: Sejuani is female; the content layer already uses she/her, so the two layers contradict on the same page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the trading lines.

audit.why: All three suspectNames ('Her Winter's Wrath', 'Land Arctic Assault', 'Hold Glacial Prison') are false positives — the names match packet.enemyAbilities exactly.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Sejuani contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — your barrel chips but Frost Armor's armour and MR eat it, and she has no detonator yet. Farm it out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sejuani must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kits: she has Arctic Assault into Permafrost and Frost Armor up, so level 3 is even — trade only when those are down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sejuani carry threat 5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in she out-scales you — Winter's Wrath percent-HP and Glacial Prison chain-CC. Peel for your team and close early.

edits.before: Q-poke Sejuani on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke Sejuani from fog angles, W as she answers, and E-slam only when her 18s Arctic Assault is down.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming at max Frost stacks — Permafrost stuns and her passive shatter does the rest.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming at max Frost stacks — Permafrost stuns and her passive shatter does the rest.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost only stuns at max Frost stacks — dodge the Winter's Wrath swipes and her E has nothing.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — E-slam + Q burst.
edits.after: Permafrost needs max Frost stacks, so dodge Winter's Wrath. Frost Armor is slow-immune — Barrel Roll's slow won't stick.

edits.before: W max and Happy Hour sustain let you win extended trades around her Permafrost and Arctic Assault cooldowns - this is your lane-control window.
edits.after: Happy Hour wins extended trades around her 18s Arctic Assault, but Frost Armor is slow-immune - your barrel won't stick till you break it first.

notes: The page told the player to 'track Permafrost's cooldown' — Permafrost is on a 1.5s cooldown and is gated on Frost stacks, not time, so that advice was structurally wrong; the real trackables are Frost stacks and the 18s Arctic Assault. Frost Armor's slow immunity (which blanks Barrel Roll's slow) and the passive shatter on stunned targets were both absent and are the highest-value additions here. Mirror sejuani__gragas already established Drunken Rage's 1-second drink tell and Frost Armor lapsing shortly after damage; this side restates the same facts, and the level chart now matches packet.levelChart on both sides.
